snippet.title: Vestibular Migraines? Try THIS!
snippet.description:
🔥 Migraines AND dizziness? Your NECK might be contributing more than you think!

If you experience dizziness, motion sickness, or sensitivity to movement during migraines, your vestibular system may not be the only area worth addressing.

💡 Here's what's happening:

⚡ Trigeminal system + migraines
Migraines involve activation of pain-processing pathways associated with the trigeminal nerve, which carries sensation from your face and head.

⚡ Migraine + balance connection
The trigeminal system interacts with brain regions involved in balance and motion processing. During migraines, this can contribute to increased sensitivity to movement and dizziness.

⚡ Your neck plays a role too
Your upper neck contains sensory receptors that tell your brain where your head is in space. When neck muscles are tense, painful, or poorly controlled, this sensory information may become less reliable and contribute to dizziness.

🛠️ Try this 3-step progression:

✅ STEP 1: Towel chin tucks
Place a towel behind your neck. Gently tuck your chin backward into it while looking slightly downward, maintaining contact with the towel.
This trains upper-neck movement and control.

✅ STEP 2: Ball + rotation
Place a ball behind your head, gently tuck into it, and slowly rotate your head side to side while maintaining control.
This challenges your neck's ability to coordinate movement in different directions.

✅ STEP 3: I-Y-T strengthening
Perform controlled I, Y, and T arm movements to strengthen the muscles supporting your shoulders, shoulder blades, and upper back.

🔥 Why this matters:
Sometimes dizziness involves overlapping contributions from the vestibular system, migraine-related sensitivity, and cervical spine.

Strengthening and retraining your neck may help improve movement tolerance and sensory control, especially when neck dysfunction is also present.

If these movements trigger dizziness, start with smaller ranges and gradually progress as your tolerance improves.

Place a towel behind your neck. Gently tuck your chin backward into it while looking slightly downward, maintaining contact with the towel.
This trains upper-neck movement and control.

✅ STEP 2: Ball + rotation
Place a ball behind your head, gently tuck into it, and slowly rotate your head side to side while maintaining control.
This challenges your neck's ability to coordinate movement in different directions.

✅ STEP 3: I-Y-T strengthening
Perform controlled I, Y, and T arm movements to strengthen the muscles supporting your shoulders, shoulder blades, and upper back.

🔥 Why this matters:
Sometimes dizziness involves overlapping contributions from the vestibular system, migraine-related sensitivity, and cervical spine.

Strengthening and retraining your neck may help improve movement tolerance and sensory control, especially when neck dysfunction is also present.

If these movements trigger dizziness, start with smaller ranges and gradually progress as your tolerance improves.

snippet.title: "VITÓRIA DOS TRABALHADORES": PAULO PAIM CELEBRA APROVAÇÃO DO FIM DA ESCALA 6X1 NO SENADO
snippet.description:
O senador Paulo Paim (PT-RS) usou a tribuna do Plenário nesta quinta-feira (15) para comemorar a aprovação da PEC 221/2019 pelo Senado Federal, matéria que extingue a jornada de trabalho na escala 6x1 e fixa o limite semanal em 40 horas sem redução salarial. O parlamentar ressaltou que a avanço social é fruto de uma longa mobilização popular e sindical, relembrando projetos de sua autoria apresentados desde a Assembleia Nacional Constituinte de 1987. Paim fez agradecimentos aos presidentes Davi Alcolumbre e Hugo Motta pelo alinhamento na tramitação das pautas trabalhistas. No mesmo discurso, o senador defendeu celeridade na apreciação da PEC da Segurança Pública, destacando que a reorganização do sistema, a integração dos órgãos de controle e o enrijecimento do regime penal são respostas fundamentais para garantir a proteção da população nos centros urbanos.

snippet.description:

· 배경: 매년 소떼를 습격하는 해충 문제와 수동 소독의 한계
· 원리: 약물을 채운 깊은 수조(Dip vat)를 통과하며 전신을 360도 소독

#축산업 #아이디어 #농장 #소떼 #혁신

snippet.title: She mocked a decorated veteran at a Purple Heart ceremony — That left everyone speechless!
snippet.description: Part 1: The lights of the grand hall shimmered against the polished wooden floors, reflecting the pride and solemn dignity of the Purple Heart ceremony. I stood there in my crisp military dress uniform, my heart beating with a mix of painful memories and quiet pride for the sacrifices I made in the line of duty. But that fleeting moment of honor was shattered in a heartbeat. Without warning, a sharp push from behind sent me crashing violently to the floor, a searing pain shooting through my broken arm. Looking up in disbelief, I saw a familiar face glaring down at me with pure venom. It was my stepmother, her eyes blazing with contempt as she spat out words designed to crush my soul: "You're nothing but trash in a uniform!" The surrounding crowd gasped, murmuring in shock as security guards rushed forward to restrain her. Even as they dragged her away kicking and screaming that those medals belonged to real fighters, I sat there paralyzed, choking back tears and unable to find my voice. A kind man and a fellow officer knelt beside me, asking if I was okay, but when I tried to speak the agonizing truth, my voice failed me. Just then, a towering shadow fell over us—a senior general stepped forward, his chest covered in decorations, his face carved from absolute stone. He looked directly at the crowd and delivered words that froze the room: "Do not finish that sentence. The woman you just insulted was the field commander that night." The silence that followed was deafening, changing everything I thought I knew about the ghosts of my past. 👇 Part 2 is pinned in the top comment!

snippet.title: BIOHAZARD | A Live-Action Resident Evil 7 Short Fan Film
snippet.description:
Ethan Winters, while searching for his missing wife, finds himself trapped by the Baker family - a deadly, unstoppable force driven to violence under the influence of a mysterious infection...

Starring: Chandler Riggs, Jason Douglas, Mary Rachel Quinn, Johnathan O'Neil, Eugenie Bondurant, Sam Coyles, Mia Cole

BIOHAZARD began as a passion project driven by a desire to bring the isolated, intense, gripping story of Resident Evil 7 into live-action. The production team spent days transforming Arturo Fuente’s original cigar factory in Tampa Bay into a full-scale section of the Baker estate, creating a practical, immersive environment specifically for the production. The film combines practical production design, practical special effects, practical stunt work, and minimal VFX to recreate the intense, physical horror of the game, while paying homage to the films that inspired it.

The production was also incentivized by Film Tampa Bay to showcase Tampa Bay as a strong, supportive, and experienced home for film productions. Riggs teamed up with Tampa-based production company Spooky Feet Films, helmed by filmmakers Shane Brady and Emily Zercher, marking their third project together. The production was additionally supported by Greg Nicotero, who provided SFX equipment for the production.

No AI was used in the making of this short film, nor may it be used to train AI.

snippet.title: Azerbaycan’da okullarda başörtüsü yasaklandı mı? #azerbaycan
snippet.description:
Azerbaycan'da hükümetin öğretmen ve öğrencilerin kıyafet kurallarıyla ilgili aldığı yeni kararın uygulanmaya başlanması sonrası protesto gösterileri düzenleniyor.

İlkokul, ortaokul ve liseleri kapsayan yeni kurallar, "okul üniformasının tekdüzeliğini bozan ve eğitimin laiklik ilkesiyle bağdaşmayan ek giyim öğelerinin" kullanılmasını yasaklıyor.

Düzenlemelerde doğrudan başörtüsüyle ilgili bir ifade bulunmasa da tesettürlü öğrenci ve öğretmenlerin okullara alınmadığı bildiriliyor.

Buna karşı başkent Bakü ve çevresindeki yerleşim yerlerinde protesto gösterileri sürüyor.

İçişleri Bakanlığı 37 kişinin gözaltına alındığını, bu kişilerin okulların normal işleyişini engellediklerini bildirdi.

Neler yaşandığını ve tartışmanın neden büyüdüğünü BBC Azerbaycanca Servisi’ne sorduk.
